seo.title: Aikido for children in Lisbon | Dojo da Luz
seo.description: Aikido for children and teenagers aged 5 to 17 in Benfica and Encarnação.

title: Growing without competition.
lead: A practice that develops the body, attention and relationships with others.
paragraphs: Aikido supports a child's physical, mental and relational development. It does not rely on physical strength: circular movements receive and guide a partner's energy.
With no competition, each child progresses at their own pace with the teacher's support. Classes combine technique, games and exercises for concentration, imagination, flexibility and reflexes.
goals: Learn the technical repertoire of Tokyo Aikikai
Train outdoors and take part in the Aiki garden
Join seminars and exchanges with other children
photoAlt: Children in an Aikido class at Dojo da Luz
trialText: Book a trial class to meet the teacher and discover the space and practice.

items.pregunta: From what age can children practise Aikido?
items.respuesta: Children's and teenagers' classes at Dojo da Luz are for ages 5 to 17 and require no previous experience.

items.pregunta: What are the timetables for children's classes?
items.respuesta: Children practise in Benfica from Monday to Friday, 18:30 to 19:30, and in Encarnação on Tuesdays and Thursdays, 17:30 to 18:30.

items.pregunta: How much is the monthly fee for children?
items.respuesta: The monthly fee for children's classes at Dojo da Luz is €25 for one class a week and €35 for two classes a week.

items.pregunta: Do children compete in the classes?
items.respuesta: Children's classes at Dojo da Luz have no competition: each child progresses at their own pace, combining Aikikai technique, games and concentration exercises.
